Scope and coverage

Manual testing checklist

Keyboard journeys: Complete primary tasks with keyboard only. Check focus order, visible focus, traps, and focus restoration.

Screen reader experience: Check reading order, names, live updates, errors, and changes of context with assistive technology.

Zoom and reflow: Check 200% text resize, 400% zoom, text spacing, and both orientations. Viewport scans do not replace these tests.

Meaning and media: Review alternative text quality, instructions, captions, transcripts, audio descriptions, and use of color.

Complete processes: Review authentication, time limits, dragging alternatives, error recovery, and all steps of important tasks.
